name: docker-game-manager
description: A Docker-native game server control panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter backend exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter frontend exec tsc -b
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
